mapper.select: SELECT ACTIVITY_ID AS activityId, ACTIVITY_NAME AS activityName, ACTIVITY_TYPE AS activityType, CAL_PER_MIN AS calPerMin, USE_YN AS useYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updateAt, WEIGHT_LEVEL AS weightLevel FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ACTIVITY_NAME ASC
